entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A planeswalker who found Ulgrotha, married Serra, and helped restore the plane before dying in a lab accident.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker who married Feroz and worked to restore Ulgrotha, then abandoned the plane after his death.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: A vampire who plots to take control of Ulgrotha under the fading Ban of Feroz.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane where Homelands is set, once beautiful and destroyed by the Wizards' Wars.

entities.name: Wizards' Wars
entities.description: The conflict that destroyed the once-beautiful plane of Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Feroz's Ban
entities.description: A protection created to guard Ulgrotha, now fading.

events.summary: Feroz comes across Ulgrotha, a plane ruined by the Wizards' Wars.
events.quote: The planeswalker Feroz came across Ulgrotha , the once-beautiful plane now destroyed by the Wizards' Wars .

events.summary: At the last unspoiled oasis Feroz meets and marries Serra; together they work to restore the plane and create Feroz's Ban.
events.quote: he met fellow planeswalker Serra , whom he married.

events.summary: Feroz dies in a lab accident and the grief-stricken Serra abandons the plane.
events.quote: Later, Feroz died during a lab accident, and the grief-stricken Serra abandoned the plane.

events.summary: With Serra gone, civilizations fight each other while Baron Sengir plots to take control under the fading Ban.
events.quote: the vampire Baron Sengir plots to take control of the plane under the fading Ban of Feroz.

relations.quote: he met fellow planeswalker Serra , whom he married.

relations.note: The Ban was created to protect the plane.
relations.quote: Together they worked to restore the plane, and to protect it, Feroz's Ban was created.

relations.note: Plots to take control under its fading.
relations.quote: the vampire Baron Sengir plots to take control of the plane under the fading Ban of Feroz.
